title: 'Onboarding flow'

---

The end customer's own onboarding: start it, read the step to render, submit that step's data, upload the documents a step asks for and accept an agreement version it owes. These routes carry no authentication because an end customer holds no operator identity; the onboarding id is the only handle, so treat it as a capability and never log or share it.
